steps.player: That beast would probably bite my fingers off if I tried to pet it.

steps.npc: If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it!

steps.player: I'm not going to pet that! It will probably bite my hand off, that filthy beast.

steps.npc: Watch who you're calling a filthy beast, human.

steps.player: Mmmm... you'd make a tasty kebab.

steps.npc: And you'd make an excellent spit bucket! Pchoo!

steps.player: I'm not going to pet that nasty creature! I might get fleas... or worse!

steps.npc: You're fairly nasty yourself, human. When was the last time you took a shower?
